public_rationale: CRAG's June 7, 2024 report found weighted hallucination rates of 17%–25% among the four industry RAG systems tested [e1]. Vectara's February 28, 2025 leaderboard reported 0.7% hallucination with 100% answer coverage for Gemini-2.0-Flash-001 on document summarization [e2]. Its November 19, 2025 report on a harder summarization benchmark reported a leading rate of 3.3% [e3]. These evaluations establish neither a general barrier to future RAG reliability nor broadly representative near-zero factual error attributable to retrieval, so they do not settle the open-ended forecast [e1, e2, e3].
limitations: The claim supplies no deadline or numerical definition of near-elimination.
The summarization benchmarks measure source faithfulness, not factual truth across representative queries, and do not isolate retrieval's contribution.
The benchmarks use different datasets; their rates do not establish a trend for a fixed system.
The packet cannot establish that no qualifying demonstration exists elsewhere.
